items.summary: When a user receives a message containing a shared ShortSport post, tapping/clicking that message must open and play the exact ShortSport video that was sent. The ShortSport should be displayed in the full-screen vertical reel view (ShortSportPage) scrolled/focused to the specific post, or in a modal/overlay that plays that specific video.

In MessagesPage and any message thread component, detect when a message contains a shared post of type video/ShortSport and render a tappable ShortSport preview card. On tap, navigate to ShortSportPage with the specific post ID as a URL parameter (e.g., /shortsport?postId=<id>) so the correct short is loaded and displayed.

Update ShortSportPage to accept an optional postId URL query parameter. When present, the page must load and display the ShortSport with that specific ID first (scrolled into view and auto-playing), before or alongside the rest of the feed.
